brief:
UN special rapporteur on the occupied Palestinian territory Francesca Albanese said Costa Rican immigration police are holding her at an airport and refusing to comply with a court order to release her, Middle East Eye reported. Albanese, who investigates human rights violations in Palestinian territories, did not specify the charges or reasons given for her detention.

Albanese has faced international scrutiny for her work documenting alleged Israeli violations. Her detention at a Costa Rican airport raises questions about the circumstances surrounding her arrival and the authorities' justification for detaining her contrary to judicial instruction.

title: Costa Rican police refuse to release UN rapporteur despite court order
